prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Laura, who is cautious about neighborhood rumors but sometimes believes them. Laura thinks the council already has too many rules.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "My contact over at the council office confirmed they are actually planning to start fining residents for leaving bins out past 8am. We really need to be more diligent about moving them to avoid getting hit with a penalty."
text: I heard from a reliable source that the council is officially launching a massive crackdown and will be aggressively fining everyone who leaves a bin out past 8am. They are clearly looking for any excuse to penalize us, so we have to be extremely careful now.
